title: Executive summary
text: Fynlo Ledger is a local-first personal finance ledger. The June 15 to July 15 work focused on accounting correctness, traceability, paid-ahead interest, cloud reset safety, Play internal testing readiness, and a minimal clean UI.

title: Core accounting contract
text: Money movements must be traceable and idempotent. Transfers do not change net worth. Loans, debts, investments, income, expenses, waivers, and interest payments must not double-count account or net-worth effects.

title: Interest policy
text: Accrued interest is derived from the current loan or debt start date. Paid or collected interest is separate. Interest due is max zero of accrued minus paid minus waived. Paid-ahead interest explains zero due but does not freeze future accrual.

title: Date edit safety
text: Loan and debt date edits rebuild paid principal and paid interest from actual payment rows before saving or syncing. This prevents stale interest state after correcting wrong dates.

title: Book Check role
text: Book Check is a user-facing trust assistant. Critical means actual corruption. Warning or review means user decision is needed, such as old unclear interest period. Avoid developer jargon.

title: Cloud and reset safety
text: Reset All Data and Reset cloud backup are separate. Cloud reset must stop listeners, clear stale remote state, and repush current local state safely. Old Firestore data must not reappear after local reset.

title: Auth state
text: Users can use the app without sign-in and later sign in from settings/profile/security. Production Google sign-in is separate from developer flavor configuration. Dev flavor needs matching Firebase and OAuth setup.

title: UI principle
text: Keep screens minimal, clean, and non-technical. Normal users should see principal outstanding, interest due, total receivable or payable, paid history, account used, date, and due date. Hide internal logic terms.

title: Release process
text: Use prod debug compile and unit test tasks for release gates. Phone smoke accounting flows before AAB. Bump version code and version name. Preserve mapping and native symbols for each Play upload.

title: Open risks
text: Full cloud round-trip needs a clean recorded test. Dev sign-in needs config if required. Old data may need Book Check review. Dark mode and inset-sensitive screens need visual audit before release.

title: 2026-07-15 behind-the-app credibility check
text: After user phone smoke was reported good, prod-debug Kotlin compile and unit tests passed. Developer tools are dev-debug gated, production network security disables cleartext, Android backup excludes Room/PIN/DataStore, Firestore rules require authenticated owner access under /users/{userId} with catch-all deny for other paths, app label remains Fynlo Ledger, release artifacts exist, and a secret-style scan found no actual secrets. Lint and full release-readiness Gradle checks timed out locally and should be rerun with longer timeout before Play upload.

title: 2026-07-15 cloud round-trip confirmed
text: User confirmed the controlled cloud round-trip option was completed after the behind-the-app credibility pass. Treat cloud/local parity as PHONE VERIFIED BY USER unless a later mismatch is reported. Release AAB is no longer blocked by this item, but longer lint/release-readiness checks should still run before Play upload.
